response.overview: European Rendezvous is a 1984 long-form experimental video album by CTI (Creative Technology Institute), a side project of Chris Carter and Cosey Fanni Tutti from the industrial group Throbbing Gristle.  It features live musical performances recorded during CTI's 1983 European tour across countries like Holland, Germany, Italy, Switzerland, and the UK.  The accompanying visuals and slide projections were created by John Lacey, with 90% of the special effects shot using domestic VHS equipment
response.title: CTI: European Rendezvous
